name: Creamy Dill Cucumber Salad
description: A cool cucumber salad in a tangy sour cream and mayo dressing with plenty of dill and lemon.

ingredients.item: red onion or shallot, thinly sliced

steps.title: Slice and salt the cucumbers
steps.text: Halve the English cucumbers lengthwise and slice thinly, about 1/8 inch, on a mandoline if you have one. Toss with 1 teaspoon kosher salt in a colander set over a bowl and let sit to draw out excess water.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: While the cucumbers drain, whisk together the sour cream, mayo, lemon juice, garlic and black pepper in a large bowl until smooth. Add the white wine vinegar if using.

steps.title: Drain and dry the cucumbers
steps.text: Press the cucumbers gently to release more liquid, then pat dry with a clean towel or paper towels. This keeps the salad from getting watery.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add the cucumbers, dill, and red onion or shallot to the dressing. Toss gently to coat.

steps.title: Chill and serve
steps.text: Let the salad sit in the fridge for at least 15 minutes so the flavors meld before serving.

notes: Salting and draining the cucumbers is the key step. Skip it and the salad turns watery fast.
Sour cream makes this richer and less tangy than a yogurt version, but it works beautifully.
For extra silkiness, swap a spoonful of crème fraîche in for the mayo.
